effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` USDC to the vault (safeTransferFrom from msg.sender).
The vault mints elixirUSDC shares to `receiver`, computed from `assets` at the current share price (rounded down), after interest accrual.
The vault supplies the USDC to Morpho Blue markets; no other effect on the signer.
formats.shown: Intent "Deposit", the USDC amount sent, a constant line "Share ticker: elixirUSDC", and the share recipient.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many elixirUSDC shares the receiver gets; the vault computes it from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.deposit: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);` Descriptor shows only `assets` and a raw `Share ticker` constant.
findings.fix: None possible in calldata; the share count depends on vault state.

findings.title: deposit intent "Deposit" does not name USDC or the elixirUSDC vault shares received.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit format: `"intent": "Deposit"`, no interpolatedIntent; field `Share ticker` is a raw constant, not an amount.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Deposit USDC for elixirUSDC shares" and add an interpolatedIntent "Deposit {assets} for shares to {receiver}".

effects: The signer sends USDC to the vault; the amount is computed from `shares` at the current share price, rounded up, and is not in the calldata.
The vault mints exactly `shares` elixirUSDC shares to `receiver`.
formats.shown: Intent "Mint", a constant line "Deposit asset: USDC" without amount, the exact shares minted, and the share recipient.

findings.title: mint does not show how much USDC leaves the signer; the amount comes from the vault share price.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.mint: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);` then ERC4626._deposit: `SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom(_asset, caller, address(this), assets);` Descriptor field `Deposit asset` shows only the ticker "USDC".
findings.fix: None possible in calldata; the only bound is the signer's USDC allowance to the vault.

findings.title: mint intent "Mint" does not say USDC leaves the wallet to pay for the shares.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint format: `"intent": "Mint"`; USDC appears only as the raw constant field `Deposit asset` = `$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker`.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Deposit USDC to mint elixirUSDC shares" and add an interpolatedIntent "Mint {shares} to {receiver}, paid in USDC".

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns elixirUSDC shares from `owner`, computed from `assets` and rounded up.
If the signer is not `owner`, the signer spends `owner`'s share allowance by that share amount.
The vault sends exactly `assets` USDC to `receiver`.
formats.shown: Intent "Withdraw", the exact USDC amount, the recipient and the owner whose shares are burned.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many shares the owner loses; the vault computes it from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.withdraw: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);` ERC4626._withdraw: `_burn(owner, shares);`

findings.title: withdraw intent and Owner label do not say the owner's vault shares are burned.
findings.evidence: descriptor withdraw format: `"intent": "Withdraw"`, field `owner` label "Owner"; ERC4626._withdraw: `_spendAllowance(owner, caller, shares); _burn(owner, shares);`
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Withdraw USDC from elixirUSDC vault" and the owner label to "Burn shares from". Add an interpolatedIntent "Withdraw {assets} to {receiver}".

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` elixirUSDC shares from `owner`.
If the signer is not `owner`, the signer spends `owner`'s share allowance by `shares`.
The vault sends USDC to `receiver`; the amount is computed from `shares` at the current share price, rounded down, with no minimum.
formats.shown: Intent "Redeem", the exact shares redeemed (vault token), the recipient and the owner.

findings.title: redeem does not show how much USDC the receiver gets; no minimum exists in the calldata.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.redeem: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);` ERC4626._withdraw: `SafeERC20.safeTransfer(_asset, receiver, assets);`

findings.title: redeem intent "Redeem" does not say USDC is received; no field names USDC.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem format: `"intent": "Redeem"`; fields are `shares`, `receiver`, `owner` only; no reference to `underlyingTicker`.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Redeem elixirUSDC shares for USDC" and add an interpolatedIntent "Redeem {shares} for USDC to {receiver}".
